limits: Compact Audit handoff only: terminal actual roster and pack session rules, saved body due records and global pending-question IDs read by canonical measurePosition. No full people, personal history, policy catalog or unrelated future records. Proposed questions not saved by the filer are NOT OBSERVED. Terminal seats do not reconstruct every historical intake.

adjournmentRule.value: The legislature sits in a regular session each year and adjourns sine die at its close.

source.note: The game's standing rule until this state's session calendar is researched: the legislature sits in a regular annual session and a measure still pending when it adjourns sine die does not carry over. This is not a reading of the state's law.

adjournmentRule.value: Congress assembles at least once every year, beginning on January 3 unless a law sets a different day.

source.note: Congress assembles at least once every year, beginning at noon on January 3 unless a law appoints a different day.

measuresDieAtAdjournment.note: A pending bill dies when the two-year Congress ends, not at each session's adjournment; the session vocabulary cannot yet say so.
